# ISuperstateRedeem
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/superstate/ISuperstateRedeem.sol)

**Title:**
Superstate Redeem Interface

Interface for the Superstate redemption mechanism.


## Functions
### redeem

Redeems Superstate Fund Tokens for USDC.

The caller MUST be on the Superstate on-chain Allowlist, and the `to` address must be allowlisted.


```solidity
function redeem(uint256 amount, address to) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount of fund tokens to redeem.|
|`to`|`address`|The address to receive the USDC payout.|
